title: Show 2D Topstitches
content: **Show 2D TopstitchesYouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5SEZXvdUv7Q ** **-** Show or hide Topstitches in the 2D window at your convenience. \- Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Materials ▶ **Show 2D Topstitches.** \- 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_Common_Stitch_View.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001177088/Toolbar_Common_Stitch_View.png)**Show 2D Topstitches.** \- Click the ![Toolbar_Common_Stitch_View.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001177088/Toolbar_Common_Stitch_View.png)**Show 2D Topstitches** tool from the 2D toolbar to hide Topstitches from the 2D Patterns. \- To show Topstitches again, click the Show 2D Topstitches tool again.
content_description: This web page provides a guide on how to conveniently show or hide 2D topstitches in your design workspace, complemented by a helpful YouTube tutorial.

title: Copy/Save Current V-Ray Render Image
content: **List of Contents** Copy/Save Current Image Copy Current Image Save Current Image Show in Saved Folder **Copy/Save Current Image YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wYtLNxCOf78 **\- Simply copy or save the image appears in the preview window to quickly utilize rendered images. * **Copy Current Image** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026411567/mceclip0.png) **Copy Current Image** tool from the Render toolbar. * **Save Current Image** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026454208/mceclip2.png) **Save Current Image** tool from the Render toolbar. ** Copy Current Image ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CJD9NEVJuf0 \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026411567/mceclip0.png) **Copy Current image** tool to copy the current preview image shown in the Render window. \- The image is copied to the clipboard and can be pasted into another program. **Save Current Image YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZG8hiYvo6WY ** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026454208/mceclip2.png) **Save Current Image** tool to save the current preview image shown in the Render window. \- The Save Image File window appears allowing you to locate the saving path. \- Name the file and locate the saving path and click Save. \- The image is saved. **Show in Saved Folder YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gev2nS8slmY ** \- To see saved images, click the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026454368/mceclip3.png) **Show in Saved Folder** tool from the Render toolbar. \- The folder located in the saving path assigned in the Image/Video Properties appears, showing saved render outputs. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to efficiently copy, save, and access rendered images from the preview window, complete with instructional videos for each process.

title: Select Mesh (Lasso)
content: **List of Conetens** Select Mesh (Lasso) Select Multiple Areas Delete Selection Invert Selection Select a Segment Select a Pattern **Select Mesh(Box) ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5wgxyUVebps \- Select and move 3D Garment mesh as needed. \- Hold down the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022721948/mceclip0.png) **Select Mesh (Box)** tool on the 3D toolbar to access the child menus. Then, select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022723088/mceclip0.png) **Select Mesh (Box)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to the Main Menu and select 3D Garment ▶ **Select Mesh (Lasso).** ** Select Multiple Areas** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6lEGdzw5QSI \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022723088/mceclip0.png) Select Mesh (Lasso) tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Patterns in the 2D window and 3D window will appear in yellow-green Mesh structure. \- Click and drag on the Pattern to freehand Lasso selection as desired to select desired area. \- Hold down the Shift and Ctrl keys on the keyboard to select multiple areas on the 3D Garment. **Delete Selection** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ITDLwSRQOWk \- To deselect particular areas, hold down the Ctrl key on the keyboard and click and drag to encompass the desired area in the 2D window. The encompassed area will be deselected. **Invert Selection** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ltsQSXzjTSY \- To invert the selection, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to click and drag on the 3D Garment. \- The areas originally not selected will be selected and vice-versa. \- The selected area will be highlighted in yellow-green. **Select a Segment** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KDWfCwXSVxA \- Double click on the Pattern outline in the 2D or 3D window to select a segment. **Select a Pattern** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GHzkQSRzp40 \- Double click within the Pattern in the 2D or 3D window to select a Pattern. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide to selecting and manipulating 3D garment meshes using various tools in the software, complete with instructional videos for each selection method.

title: Fit Map
content: **List of Contents** Fit Map Can't Wear vs. Tight **Fit Map** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bcfy2_Zy-bo \- Check the tightness of 3D Garments with the color scale. \- Hover over the third icon in the Vertical View Toggle Menu in the 3D window and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022307467/mceclip1.png) **Fit Map** icon. ** Can't Wear vs. Tight** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mSg9OyWzgp4 \- When the **Fit Map** icon is selected, the 3D Garment will appear in white, yellow, and red, each indicating the tightness of the 3D Garment. \- Red shows the **Cant’ Wear** areas on the 3D Garment, where the Garment is too tight, not possible to wear in real life. \- The percentage of the Can’t Wear areas will show on the Can’t Wear box’s right. \- Yellow shows the **Tight** areas on the 3D Garment, where the Garment is tight. \- The percentage of the Tight areas will show on the Tight box’s right. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide users with a comprehensive guide on utilizing the Fit Map feature in 3D garment design to assess and visualize areas of tightness and wearability.

title: Edit UV
content: **Edit UV** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dqwzpG9MAbM \- Change the Pattern placement and edit the UV layout in the 2D Window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022193908/mceclip0.png) **Edit** **UV** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to and select Main Menu ▶ Material ▶ **Edit** **UV.** * **Automatic YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cLwBhd191YI \- **The **Automatic** option is set as default. \- When the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022193908/mceclip0.png) **Edit** **UV** tool’s setting is set as Automatic, the UV area will be automatically assigned, surrounding all Patterns in the 2D window. * **Manual ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OR7A6sds7bE \- The marquee box surrounding all Patterns in the 2D window will appear when the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022193908/mceclip0.png)**Edit UV** tool is activated. \- Click the icon on the right top of the marquee box. \- The ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022193908/mceclip0.png)**Edit UV** tool’s setting will be changed to Manual, allowing users to manually edit the UV area. \- When the marquee box changes to light blue, click and drag the marquee box to resize the UV area. \- Select and move the Patterns to rearrange them within the UV area.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to edit UV layouts in the 2D window using both automatic and manual settings, complete with instructional YouTube videos for visual assistance.

Once the Default Buttonhole style is modified, it lasts until rerun of the program and it is unable to be deleted. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115004772168/KakaoTalk_20170201_115851767.png)

title: HASP driver settings for CLO offline-auth products
content: ## **The Latest HASP driver download (updated June 2022)** * Mac: <https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/Sentinel_Runtime_94691.tar> * Linux: <https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/aksusbd-8.31.1.tar> * Windows: <https://cdn.clo3d.com/HASP/haspdinst_8_31.exe> **Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on Windows ** **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Sentinel HASP Driver which is suitable for your operating system. ** Operation** **Installing Sentinel Driver on Windows** 1. Download the latest HASP driver (See above) 2. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to install the driver. 3. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-i" behind the automatically entered path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to install. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000773648) 4. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/) and check to see if the following screen appears to see if the HASP Driver has been successfully installed. If the following screen appears, then installation is successful. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000727667) 5. If the following error occurs, the HASP Driver must be deleted and reinstalled. HASP Driver Deletion ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000727627) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000727647)[ ](http://krmanual.clo3d.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=3375386) **Deleting Sentinel Driver on Windows ** 1. Download the latest HASP driver (see above) ** ** 2. Enter "CMD" in 'Windows Start Button + Run (R)' to delete the driver. ![22.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000410027) 3. Drag the downloaded haspdinst.exe file and put it on the CMD window to automatically register the corresponding path as shown underlined below. Enter "-purge -r" behind the corresponding path and press 'Enter' on keyboard to delete. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000774248) 4. After the driver has been successfully deleted, refer to the following content to reinstall the driver. HASP Driver Installation **Sentinel HASP Driver Errors on MAC ** **Objective** The Sentinel HASP Diver is automatically installed with the software, but it fails occasionally. Please download and install the Mac OS Sentinel HASP Driver. ** Operation** **Installing Sentinel Driver on Mac ** * Download the latest HASP driver (see above) * ver 21.0 Build 77815 Sentinel Driver for Mac Supported Platforms: Mac OS X 10.9.x, 10.10.x, 10.11.x, 10.12.x, 10.13.x [https://s3.clo3d.com/sentinel/7.80/Sentinel_Runtime.dmg](https://s3.clo3d.com/sentinel/7.80/Sentinel_Runtime.dmg) * macOS Catalina 10.15 users, please download Sentinel Driver here <https://s3.clo3d.com/sentinel/Sentinel_Runtime.dmg> 1. Please remove all the dongle keys inserted into the Mac PC installation to be done. 2. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" (ver 21.0 Build 77815) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000781588) 3. Double-click the **Install Sentinel Runtime Environment** icon. 4. Please allow the 'hasplmd' application to accept incoming network connections (this message may not appear). 5. Access to [http://localhost:1947](http://localhost:1947/)** ** 6. If you are unable to connect to the URL, try again after 10 seconds later. If it still does not work, reboot and connect again. If the solutions above do not work, please go back to the first step and check again. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000730047) *If you click **Diagnostics** , License Manager Version appears with newly installed version; ver 21.0 Build 77815 (Version information of 21.0 Build 77815 appears as this in Diagnostics). ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000781668) 7. Insert Dongle key into USB port. 8. If the Dongle key appears in 'Sentinel Keys', the installation is successfully done. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000781628) **Reinstalling Sentinel on Mac ** 1. Please remove all the dongle keys from USB port. 2. Mount "Sentinel_Runtime.dmg" with version of "ver 21.0 Build 77815". ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000783728) 3. Double-click **Uninstall Sentinel Runtime Environment**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000783688) 4. Click **Uninstall**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000783708) 5. If the un-installation is done normally, the dialog above appears. Please press **OK** button and then click **Quit**. 6. Reboot your Mac. 7. Install Sentinel Driver. Please refer to the following method; Reinstall Sentinel Driver on Mac *If you don't follow the guideline, you may not be able to find Dongle keys inserted into your PC or other PCs. Also the other PCs may not be able to find your Dongle key. **Sentinel Driver Known Bugs ** * Sentinel LDK Protection System Error : invalid XML scope (36) Normally occurred when operating in CLO3D modelist network dongle 1.4.14.7701 (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 6.4 version or before 6.4). * Occurs with the following conditions: → Network Dongle key (not a local Dongle key) → CLO3D Modelist Network with 2.1.44 or later version. (Enveloped with Sentinel LDK 7.1) → The Dongle key is inserted into another PC. → The version of Sentinel Driver is 13.20 in your Mac. → Operates normally after reinstalling with Mac Sentinel Driver ver 16.0. * If multiple Sentinel Drivers are mounted, the software is unable to find virtual files. If a driver is already mounted, please demount(or eject) it and mount new driver. * Sentinel Driver starts to operate in a few seconds. On occasion, it does not start. In that case, please reboot your PC. * All the Dongle keys should be removed when uninstalling Sentinel Driver. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115000784048) Go Back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides the latest downloads and installation instructions for the Sentinel HASP driver across Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms, aimed at resolving driver errors and ensuring proper functionality.

title: Video Capture (Preview and Edit)
content: **Objective** Play preview and edit video. ** Location** **Turntable Video Capture Preview (Preview window that appears after the recording)** ** Operation** **Preview** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: **Turntable Video Capture Preview (Preview window that appears after the recording)** 2. Utilize below buttons as needed. ****※Note: Preview Option **** **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001366188/ani_btn_left_double_over.png) Start** | Moves to beginning of the play area. ---|--- **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001324007/ani_btn_play_over.png) Play** | Plays the play area. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001366208/ani_btn_stop_over.png) Pause** | Pauses temporarily on the play area. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001366168/ani_btn_right_double_over.png) End** | Moves to end of the play area. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001366148/ani_btn_re_over.png) Repeat** | Repeats the play area. **Edit** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: **Turntable Video Capture Preview (Preview window that appears after the recording)** 2. Click where to edit on the timeline. → Frame bar appears. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001324087/Video_Capture_Frame_bar.png) 3. Right click on the frame bar, click 'Split'. → The split play area is now being separated from the timeline. 4. Unnecessary part is deletable by right-clicking and pressing 'Delete'. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001366288/Video_Capture_delete.jpg)
content_description: "Preview and edit your Turntable video captures seamlessly with intuitive controls and timeline editing features."

title: Direct Positioning
content: ### **Objective** Activate Direct Positioning to click to easily arrange Patterns and OBJs. ** Location** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001243228/_______.png) **Select/Move** ▶ Click 3D Pattern or OBJ ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001194367/image2015-9-15_14-44-58.png) **Direct Positioning** ** Operation** 1. Follow the path: 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001243228/_______.png) **Select/Move** ▶ Click 3D Pattern or OBJ ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001194367/image2015-9-15_14-44-58.png) **Direct Positioning** 2. title: Divide Internal Lines
content: **List of Contents** Divide Internal Line Divide Internal Point Divide Internal Line(Apply) **Divide Internal Line YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VAfCSnJjEgA ** \- Divide Internal Lines based on points or segments. \- Right click on a point and select**Divide Internal Point** from the pop-up menu. \- Right click on an Internal Line and select **Divide Internal Line** from the pop-up menu. **Divide Internal Point YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MN-gmXfj6rk ** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026626228/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Right click on a point of joined Internal Lines. \- Select **Divide Internal Point** to divide Internal Lines based on the selected point. \- The selected point is no longer filled. **Divide Internal Line(Apply) YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G3Pb9sf2lwc ** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026626228/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Right click on an Internal Line. \- Select **Divide Internal Line** to cut the select Internal Line from other joined Internal Lines. \- Both ends of the selected Internal Line are no longer filled. title: Move Fastened Button/Buttonhole
content: **List of Contents** Move Fastened Button/Buttonhole Move Fastened Button Move Fastened Button and Buttonhole **Move Fastened Button/Buttonhole YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W6jvAKLSUR8 ** \- Move fastened buttons and buttonholes together at once. \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026625188/mceclip0.png) **Select/Move** Button tool from the 3D toolbar. **Move Fastened Button YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RpZR2GSBwK4 ** \- Click and drag the button to be moved in the 2D or 3D window. \- The button is moved to the position when the mouse is released. \- The button stays fastened. **Move Fastened Button and Buttonhole YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JFfyojm4nMk ** \- Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard and select a button and a buttonhole. \- Click and drag the selected button and buttonhole. \- Release the mouse to complete moving. \- The button and buttonhole remain fastened. title: [Popup] Duplicate as Buttonhole to Symmetric Pattern
content: ### **Objective** Duplicate buttons as buttonholes, or buttonholes as buttons, to its Symmetric Pattern. **Location ** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_3D_Button_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115015218607/Toolbar_3D_Button_Edit.png) **Select/Move Button** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_3D_Button_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115015218607/Toolbar_3D_Button_Edit.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Click on the button or buttonhole to be duplicated to its Symmetric Pattern. → The selected button or buttonhole is highlighted in yellow. 3. Right-click on the selected button or buttonhole. → The right-click pop-up menu appears. 4. Depending on the selected item, select **Duplicate as Button to Symmetric Pattern** or **Duplicate as Buttonhole to Symmetric Pattern**. → The selected button or buttonhole is duplicated as a buttonhole or button, depending on the selected item, to its Symmetric Pattern.
content_description: This web page guides users on how to duplicate buttons and buttonholes to their Symmetric Pattern using the 3D Toolbar in CLO 3D.

title: Property Editor
content: **List of Contents** Property Editor Simulation Properties **Objective** Edit selected item's properties in the Property Editor. **Operation** **Property Editor** **Pattern Property** | Shows a pattern’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected ---|--- **Internal Shape Property** | Shows an internal shape’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Sewing Property** | Shows a sewing line's property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Stitch Property** | Shows a stitch's property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Sewing Style Property** | Shows a sewing style’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Fabric Property** | Shows a pattern’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected from the fabric list. **Button Property** | Shows a button’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Buttonhole Property** | Shows a buttonhole’s property on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Avatar Property** | Shows the pattern-related properties of an avatar on the Property Editor when it is selected. **Simulation Property** | Shows the simulation properties on the Property Editor. Right click on the 3D Pattern Window and select Simulation Property from the pop-up menu. **Wind Property** | Shows the wind properties on the Property Editor. Right click on the 3D Pattern Window and select Wind Property from the pop-up menu. **2D Window Property** | Shows the 2D Pattern Window properties on the Property Editor. Right click on the 2D Pattern Window and select 2D Pattern Window Property from the pop-up menu. **Simulation Property** 1. Follow and select the menu as below. Right-click Pop-Up Menu (on 3D Window) ▶ **Simulation Properties** → Open, save, and edit properties related to Simulation in the Property Editor. **※ Note:** * **Select All with Same Property:** Right-click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Patterns) ▶ Select All with Same Property ▶ **Particle Distance** / **Layer** / **Fabric** → Patterns with the same property is selected. * **Calculator:** Right click on the numeric field to be edited and select **Calculator** option to calculate and apply desired result directly in CLO (ver4.2.0). ![calculator_en.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003066328/calculator_en.gif) * To convert units, click the **Convert** option from the Calculator. When the Calculator changes to unit conversion calculator, type in the desired number, select appropriate units, and click = (equal sign). Then, the typed in value is converted to appropriate unit. To apply the result to the Property Editor, please select **OK** (ver4.2.0). When the converted unit mismatches with the program's unit, the value is applied as the program's unit, not the converted unit (ver4.2.0). * **Item No.:** In each item's Property Editor, insert its item number. (ver 5.2) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive guide for editing and managing various properties of selected items within the Property Editor in a simulation environment.

title: Reverse Arrangement Horizontally/Vertically

title: Fold Seam Line
content: ### **Objective** Use this function to create an pressing effect on sewn parts of Patterns. **Location** Pattern Property Editor ▶ Fold ▶ **Fold Angle** **Operation** 1. Click on ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005491927/Toolbar_Common_Sewing_Edit.png) **Edit Sewing** tool. 2. Select the seamline to change its fold angle. 3. Follow the indicated guideline below: Pattern Property Editor ▶ Fold ▶ **Fold Angle** 4. Adjust the value, in the range of 0~360˚. **※ Note:** * The value of fold angle is in between 0° to 360°, 180° represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0˚, and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360˚. * **Fold Strength ** The intensity of the fold is able to be set by adjusting the value of **Fold Strength**. The higher the value, the closer the fold is to the set angle. When a jacket and its lining are sewn together, the sewn area inflates due to the default sewing angle and intensity values. In this case, sets the **Fold Strength** to 0 to flatten the sewn boundaries. * When the Sewing type is set as **Turned** , **Fold Strength** and **Fold Angle** cannot be modified (ver4.0.0).
content_description: This webpage provides instructions for adjusting the fold angle and strength of sewn parts in patterns using the Pattern Property Editor to achieve desired pressing effects.

title: Elastic
content: **List of Contents** Elastic Applicable Items Apply Elastic Simulation Elastic Strength Elastic Ratio Segment Length Total Length **Elastic** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f48APJ0xKog \- Apply Elastic to Pattern outlines and Internal Lines to shrink or stretch 3D Patterns. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021992087/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar and select the Pattern outline or the Internal Line as desired. Then, navigate to the Property Editor and toggle on **Elastic.** ** Applicable Items** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NrbiPOW5c_E \- Elastic can be applied to all Pattern outlines. \- Elastic can be applied to all Internal Lines. **Apply Elastic** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GCQY8ota7_8 \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021992087/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar and select the segment where Elastic should be applied to. \- Elastic can also be applied to a whole Pattern by selecting it with the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022194728/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool. \- Once the desired item is selected, navigate to the Property Editor and toggle on **Elastic.** \- Elastic will be applied to the selected items. **Simulation** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qi68kaJyvks \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022133907/mceclip1.png) Simulation tool from the 3D toolbar. \- The elastic will be applied to 3D Garments. **Elastic Strength** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Htoeye3sikg \- Elastic Strength refers to the Elastic resistance. \- The default value is 10. Greater the Elastic Strength is, lesser affected by outside influence and maintain Elastic Ratio. \- It is recommended to set the Elastic Strength to 10. **Elastic Ratio** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QSVYrjT_ppk \- Elastic Ratio indicates by what percentage the selected Pattern outlines or Internal Lines will shrink or stretch. \- 100% is the original length of the selected Pattern outlines or Internal Lines. Smaller the percentage is, shorter the length is. \- The Elastic Ratio can be adjusted between 0 and 200. **Segment Length** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FtHJw8ufDEg \- Type in the desired segment length of the selected Pattern outlines or Internal Lines after the Elastic is applied. \- The Elastic Ratio will be automatically calculated when the Segment Length is assigned. 。 **Total Length** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=80NfdFjkV_A \- Select multiple segments and type in the desired length for the sum of selected segments. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on applying elastic properties to 3D patterns, including detailed instructions, applicable items, and instructional videos for effective simulation and adjustment of elastic strength and ratio.

title: Dart
content: **List of Contents** Dart Create Dart Create Dart with Specific Values **Dart** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wu-cknKD5zw \- Create Dart on Patterns. Because Patterns can be sewn without seam allowances in CLO, Dart will be sewn with the Pattern outlines. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar or navigate to and select Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Dart.** ** Create Dart** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qTPxmGmM-7E \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and click and drag within a Pattern. \- The preview of the Dart will appear. \- Release the mouse to complete the Dart. **Create Dart with Specific Values** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Zw15iDys3Q \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and click once within a Pattern. \- The Create Dart window will appear. \- Enter desired values to the Create Dart window and select OK. * **Size** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=silafU2IVJo \- Assign Width (Left), Width (Right), Height (Up), and Height (Down) which are measured from the center of the Dart. * **Position** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-l1vyDxjqks \- Assign the placement of the Dart. * **Outline** \- Enter Left, Right, Up, and Down values which indicate the margin between the Dart and the Pattern outline. * **Center** \- Enter Left, Right, Up, and Down values which are measured from the center of the Dart Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide to creating and customizing darts in CLO 3D, featuring instructional videos and step-by-step instructions for various dart creation methods.

title: [Popup] Copy/Paste Buttonhole
content: **List of Contents** Copy/Paste Buttonhole Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Paste Buttonhole ### ### **Objective** Copy and paste multiple buttonholes with keeping the interval space evenly. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button ** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** **Operation** **Copy/Paste Buttonhole** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Right click on an existing buttonhole, then select **Copy (Ctrl+C)** from the pop-up menu. 3. Right click again, then select **Paste (Ctrl+V)** from the pop-up menu. 4. Click on a desired place to locate the copy of the buttonhole. **Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Pase Buttonhole** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Right click on an existing buttonhole, then select **Copy (Ctrl+C)** from the pop-up menu. 3. Right click again, then select **Paste (Ctrl+V)** from the pop-up menu. 4. Right click on a desired place to locate the copy of the buttonhole. →The Paste window appears. 5. Input desired value for interval/number of buttonholes/position. **Interval** | Sets the distance between buttonholes. ---|--- **Number of Buttons/Buttonholes** | Sets the number of buttonholes to copy/paste. **Position** | Sets the position of the center of the copied button/buttonhole from the left/right/top/bottom of the pattern outline (ver2.5.0). 6. Click **OK**. → The buttonholes are now being created and applied accordingly. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for efficiently copying and pasting multiple buttonholes in a design, ensuring even spacing and precise positioning.

title: [Property] Topstitch Corner Type
content: **List of Contents** Curved Corner Right Angled Corner **Objective** Set Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. **※ Note:** If stitch type is Overlock, set the corner type to Curved for smoother extension. **Location** Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Curved/Right Angled ▶ **On** / **Off** ### Operation **Curved Corner** 1. Select a Topstitch with ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005619787/_________.png) **Edit Topstitch** tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Curved ▶ **On** → The selected Topstitch is now being curved and smoothly extended. ![rightangledcorner.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115023689328/rightangledcorner.png) **Right Angled Corner** 1. Select a Topstitch with ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005619787/_________.png) **Edit Topstitch** tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Right Angled ▶ **On** → The selected topstitch is now being a right angle. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides guidance on how to set and customize corner types for topstitching in the Topstitch Property Editor to achieve smoother stitch extensions at corners.
